adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new `deleteEvent` calendarId selection is incorrect:

```ts
const calendarId = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```

When `externalCalendarId` is not provided (falsy), the `find` predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` where `externalCalendarId` is `undefined`/`null`, so it will usually match nothing and yield `undefined`. Unlike `createEvent`, this path does not fall back to `"primary"` (even though `defaultCalendarId` is declared), so `calendar.events.delete` can be invoked with `calendarId: undefined`, breaking deletion for events without an explicit `externalCalendarId` reference.
